Philip Coker

Preserved Primary Document • coker-p1.htm

Ennumerated nearby was Patty Coker (age 14-26) living alone and Moses Coker . This strongly suggests a connection between Philip, Patty and Moses and, by extension, Moses' brother, Daniel Coker. It is highly likely that Philip was the father of Patty, Moses and Daniel although more work must be done to prove the connection. If so, then it is likely Philip was born sometime before 1745.
